title: Gideon and the Visitor
author: Petra Whitlock
blurb: Mirabel Nystrom, an urban explorer mapping tunnels that aren't on any survey, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. Then the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must learn the song's last verse without singing along before the frost writes its final pattern.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
